statement: Find all quadratic polynomials \(p(x)\) with rational coefficients such that the set of all roots of \(p(x)\) equals the set of all coefficients of \(p(x)\).
(a) Prove there are no positive integers \(a, b\) such that \(\dfrac{\text{lcm}(a,b)}{a+b} = 2025\). (b) Are there positive integers \(a, b, c\) such that \(\dfrac{\text{lcm}(a,b,c)}{a+b+c} = 2025\)?

Fifu and Gian build a sequence: Fifu picks 1 as the first term; then they alternate picking the next term (any positive integer \(\leq n\) on the \(n\)-th turn). The game ends when the sum \(\geq 2025\); the player who picks the last term wins. Prove Fifu has a winning strategy.

Acute triangle \(ABC\) with \(D, E\) on \(AB, AC\) such that \(B, C, E, D\) lie on circle \(\Gamma\). \(F\) on \(\Gamma\) with \(EF \parallel AB\). \(G \neq F\) on \(\Gamma\) with \(A, G, F\) collinear. \(H = AB \cap CG\). \(I\) is the midpoint of \(BD\), and \(J\) on \(AB\) with \(H\) the midpoint of \(AJ\). Prove \(CEJI\) is cyclic.

Find all functions \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) satisfying: \(f(x + f(y)) = f(x) + f(y)\) for all \(x, y\); there exists \(x\) with \(f(x) = \frac{1}{2025}\); there is no \(x\) with \(0 < f(x) < \frac{1}{2025}\). Determine all possible images of \(f\).

For every positive integer \(n\), let \(f(n)\) be the number of ordered pairs \((x, y)\) with \(x, y \leq n\) and \(\gcd(x, y, n) = 1\). Prove that for any composite \(n\), \(f(n) \leq n^2 - n\), and determine all \(n\) with equality.

Let \(ABC\) be acute with circumcenter \(O\). Points \(D, E\) on the circumcircle satisfy \(AD \perp BC\) and \(BE \perp CA\). Segment \(CD\) meets the circle with diameter \(DO\) at \(P\); segment \(CE\) meets the circle with diameter \(EO\) at \(Q\). Prove \(OP = OQ\).

A positive integer \(n\) is asri if \(n = ab + 20a + 25b\) for positive integers \(a, b\). (a) Prove there exists a non-asri positive integer greater than 2025. (b) Prove there exist 26 consecutive asri positive integers.
